decision: Derive a concise local skill; do not install a complete upstream specialist.
contract: TypeScript judgments that keep compile-time claims consistent with domain contracts and runtime behavior.

method.scope: Complete tracked-path inventories for every supplied repository, followed by text screening of canonical skills, agents, rules and relevant development guides. Selected relevant entrypoints and references were read as recorded below. This is not a line-by-line audit of every file or application in these repositories.
method.exclusions: Translations and host mirrors were de-duplicated. Large application repositories were scoped to agent and development instruction sources; fixtures, application code and unrelated product documentation were not comprehensively read.

primary_source: cursor/plugins: pstack, authored by Lauren Tan

repositories.reason: pstack supplies the central criterion: strengthen a type when an operation needs a guarantee, rather than pursuing precision for its own sake. Keep state modeling, meaningful brands, boundary parsing, honest predicates, exhaustiveness, and schema ownership.
repositories.review_depth: Read the complete TypeScript entrypoint and linked patterns, all 24 pstack principles, and the Cursor Team exhaustiveness rule. Repository discovery also covered other teams rather than treating Cursor as one author.
repositories.intentionally_excluded: Do not copy host-specific invocation metadata, mandatory object arguments, logger policy, universal branding, a fixed narrowing hierarchy, automatic scripts, or unconditional internal trust. A number duration still permits negative values; mutable tuples and readonly views do not establish lifetime invariants.

repositories.reason: The guide explicitly distinguishes generated types from validation and readonly/as const from runtime immutability. Retain these cautions and avoid changing optionality or public interfaces merely to satisfy a style preference.

repositories.decision: Considered; do not import broad mandatory policies

retain: Strengthen only where the required operation needs a guarantee.
Model dependent variants and meaningful identity distinctions.
Parse untrusted input at its owner and keep predicates truthful in both branches.
Account for mutation, absence and ignored async callbacks.
Check the actual program, runtime host and package consumer.
omit: Language syntax tutorials and catalogs of advanced utility types.
Project-specific naming, enum/interface preferences, formatting and folder layout.
Mandatory dependencies or strictness migrations unrelated to the task.
React architecture, general code review, error recovery and delivery orchestration.
design.selection_basis: Editorial selection based on failure modes present in the reviewed sources and technical counterexamples. No measured claim about how frequently an AI agent forgets these rules or that this skill improves its behavior.

official_sources.supports: Predicates have if-and-only-if semantics; explicit predicates are not implementation proofs.
Readonly properties and aliasing do not establish runtime immutability.
A contextual void callback may return an ignored value; generics should express relationships.
Unchecked index access is a distinct compiler option.
Optional-property exactness is a distinct compiler option.
paths does not rewrite emitted specifiers; type-only imports are erased.
void does not handle a promise rejection.
